question: Pila ang application fee ug kinatas-ang tax cap sa pagkuha ug FSEC sa Bureau of Fire Protection?
answer: Wala akoy nakit-an nga impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter tungkol sa application fee ug kinatas-ang tax cap sa pagkuha ug FSEC sa Bureau of Fire Protection. [S1, S2, S3]

ground_truth: Applying for a Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC) requires an application fee of PHP 200.00 plus Fire Code Construction Tax (FCCT) of 0.1% of verified estimated value (materials and labor) up to PHP 50,000.00 maximum.
